independent_computation.method: The scenario's input tuple is not present in the permitted evidence tree (data/ carries no golden scenario definitions), so the leaf was reconstructed by exact decomposition: every Syndra damage term is an affine (W: quadratic) function of AP built only from the wiki rows above, so both the old and the new total were solved for an integer AP and an integer cast/sphere multiset. A search over all rank tuples (Q,W,E in 1-5, R in 1-3), cast counts 0-6 and sphere counts 0-10, requiring an integer AP and requiring the 650.0 delta to equal one whole wiki-sourced component, returned 32 exact fits - and every one of them attributes the delta to exactly one additional Dark Sphere (Q) cast (a handful of AP=750 fits allow 'one E cast' as an alternate label for the same 650). No fit exists in which the delta is a formula/scaling change, a true-damage term, or a partial cast.

reconstructed_inputs.ranks: Q5 W5 E3 R3 (= 16 points, i.e. level 16; R3 supplies the 30 ability haste on Dark Sphere)
reconstructed_inputs.casts_in_window: W x2, E x1, R x1, Q x3 (old) vs Q x4 (new)
reconstructed_inputs.target: effective magic resist 0 - both totals are exact sums of raw wiki damage, so m(R)=100/(100+R)=1

independent_computation.alternate_fit_same_conclusion: AP=600, Q5 W5, R rank 2 (sphere = 120+0.20*600 = 240), no E cast: 4*650 + 2*719.2 + 4*240 = 4998.4 and 5*650 + 2*719.2 + 4*240 = 5648.4. Different rank/cast bookkeeping, identical delta semantics: one extra Dark Sphere cast worth 650.0.
independent_computation.delta_semantics: delta = 650.0 = exactly one Dark Sphere cast at rank 5 with 600 AP (230 + 70% AP), unmitigated. The change adds one Q cast to the fight window; it does not alter any per-cast formula (every per-cast value above is unchanged between old and new).
why_the_added_cast_is_the_correct_side: Two wiki-sourced mechanics both push Dark Sphere's cast count UP in this exact scenario state, and both are live at 60 splinters / R rank 3: (a) 'Collecting 40 Splinters of Wrath causes Syndra to periodically stock a Dark Sphere charge, up to a maximum of 2' - two charges are available at window open; (b) R's passive 'Dark Sphere's cooldown is reduced equivalent to an amount of ability haste' [10,20,30] - at R3 the 7 s recharge becomes 7*100/130 = 5.3846 s by the quoted ability-haste identity.

Cast-count walk with both mechanics honoured: casts at t=0, t=0 (the two stocked charges), t=5.3846, t=10.769 -> 4 casts, which is exactly the new value's Q count. Dropping either mechanic yields 3 casts over the same window (7 s recharge -> t=0,0,7; or a single charge -> t=0,5.3846,10.769), which is exactly the old value's Q count.

No text in the cached wiki data supports withholding either mechanic at 60 splinters: 60 is above the 40-splinter charge threshold, and the R ability-haste passive is unconditional. The old value is therefore the state in which one wiki-stated Dark Sphere mechanic was not being paid; the new value pays it.

residual_uncertainty: The fight window length and the attacker's non-R ability haste are not present in the permitted evidence tree (no golden scenario definitions live under data/), so the cast-count walk above is reconstructed rather than read. The reconstruction pins the delta with certainty - it is exactly one Dark Sphere cast of 650.0, and both totals decompose exactly - and the direction of the change is the direction the cached wiki text supports (2 stocked charges at >=40 splinters; R's 10/20/30 ability haste on Dark Sphere's cooldown). The verdict would only flip if the engine's fight window were short enough (< 10.77 s at R3 haste) that a fourth Dark Sphere charge could not have recharged in time; that window length is exactly the datum the evidence tree does not carry. Confidence: moderate-high on new_value_correct, high on 'the delta is one Dark Sphere cast and no per-cast formula changed'.
